inlines.v: PANG, noun Extreme pain; anguish; agony of body; particularly, a sudden paroxysm of extreme pain, as in spasm, or childbirth. Isaiah 21:3. I saw the hoary traitor, Grin in the pangs of death, and bit the ground. PANG, verb transitive To torture; to give extreme pain to.
